tease_ok.description: The member's "OK to be teased" opt-in (default false). Always sent by the server; optional so earlier fixtures stay valid.

running_joke.description: The admins' running-joke note (1-80 characters of plain text), kept after an opt-out; null when none. Always sent by the server; optional so earlier fixtures stay valid.

MemberPatch.description: Body of PATCH /api/admin/members/{id}; every field optional. `persona: ""` (or `default`) clears the reply style, `running_joke: ""` clears the note. The note is trimmed and refused with 422 `note_too_long` past 80 characters, `note_not_plain` with a mention, an @ or # handle, a link, markdown or a line break, and `note_names_member` when it contains any roster member's display name, nickname or alias or any roster character's IGN (case-insensitive, as a whole word).

voice.description: The profile's one-line voice; empty when it has none.
